title: Cyber Invaders
description: Tactical space defense arcade shmup. Pilot the neon interceptor, shred descending alien fleets through destructible energy bunkers, intercept mystery UFO sweeps, and collect plasma power-ups.
author: AwaisGames Studio

controls.desktop: A / D or Left / Right Arrows to pilot · Spacebar to fire plasma cannons · P to Pause
controls.mobile: Touch Left / Right screen edges or drag joystick to maneuver · Auto-fires continuously
